Order 
This petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India has been filed seeking the following reliefs:-
"i.

To Issue a writ in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondents to produce the entire records pertaining to the subject matter and after kind perusal of it, Direct the respondents to quash the action of the respondents to construct the road in the land of the petitioner from Balupura Neher kiPuliya to Pathrauaa Village without following the procedure of land Acquisition Act.

ii. To Issue a writ in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondents to pay the compensation for their illegal works within a stipulated as this court thinks fit,
looking to the facts and circumstances of the case in the interest of justice.
iii. sue any other writ, order or direction as this Hon'ble court deemed fit and proper."

sentences.text: In view of the decision taken by Executive Engineer P.W.D. Division Morena with regard to resolving the title dispute and decision not to go ahead the construction till the demarcation report is received, this Court is of considered opinion that for the time being nothing survives in this writ petition.

Accordingly, this petition is disposed of on the following directions:-
i. Construction shall remain stopped on the disputed lands unless and until demarcation report is received.

ii. If it is found that construction of road on the private land of petitioner is necessary,
then it shall be done only after acquiring the land or after purchasing the land by private negotiation and prior thereto, nothing will be done on the land belonging to the petitioner.

iii. In case if it is found that road is being constructed on the government land and if petitioner is not satisfied with the demarcation report, then he shall have liberty to challenge the demarcation report in accordance with law.
9. With aforesaid observation, the petition is disposed of.
